title: The long shadow of a short fuse
summary_en: Parent‑teen friction may seem fleeting, but new Iowa State research shows those tense adolescent moments can echo through a family for decades. A multigenerational study finds that harsh parenting in adolescence can weaken bonds not only between parents and adult children, but between grandparents and grandchildren as well.
title_cn: The long shadow of a short fuse

title: Initiative to strengthen rural communities through biomanufacturing receives $15 million in federal funding
summary_en: An Iowa State University-led research initiative to bolster the economic vitality of rural communities is one of 12 projects selected for the National Science Foundation’s Regional Innovation Engines (NSF Engines) awards. RuralSTAMINA is focused on creating new value-added products through the discovery and commercialization of innovations in biomass conversion and biomanufacturing.
title_cn: Initiative to strengthen rural communities through biomanufacturing receives $15 million in federal funding
